Combined with the `!Number.isInteger` check, any integer value (e.g. 9999, -50) passes validation and is persisted via `Review.updateReview(reviewId, { rating })`, bypassing the intended 1-5 bound. ORDER BY ${sort}`, [bookId]) ... } ``` `sort` is raw user query input interpolated directly into the SQL string with no whitelist, unlike the sibling `getBooksPage`, which uses `BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS` whitelist mapping. `all()` just executes the raw string (confirmed via db/index.js pattern used elsewhere — only `bookId` is parameterized, `sort` is not).
